rubrics_metrics.name: Aim for historical accuracy over spectacle (producer guideline)
rubrics_metrics.description: In staging the play Charles Kean states: 'Accuracy, not show, has been my object; and where the two coalesce, it is because the one is inseparable from the other.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reviving historical plays, prioritize factual/historical fidelity in costumes, heraldry, and scenic representation; select incidents that illustrate the historical narrative rather than mere spectacle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retain Chorus as connecting descriptive element (producer guideline)
rubrics_metrics.description: Retain the descriptive poetry assigned to the 'Chorus' between the acts as a peculiar feature connecting and explaining the action; substitute Time with Clio (Muse of History) to serve the play's effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Chorus to guide audiences' imagination and to compress/bridge events across time; preserve its poetic expository function in revival.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use period-appropriate music and substantial chorus (producer guideline)
rubrics_metrics.description: Select music partly from ancient airs contemporary with the play's period and partly composed to accord with that period; for effect, a large chorus (e.g., fifty singers) may be engaged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate authentic or period-inspired musical selections (e.g., 'Song on the Victory of Agincourt', 'Chanson Roland') and allocate sufficient vocal forces to achieve the intended historical atmosphere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model episodic scenes on primary eyewitness sources (producer guideline)
rubrics_metrics.description: When compressing or selecting incidents for an episode (e.g., the London reception episode), model the scene upon reliable primary sources or eyewitness accounts to regulate the general representation of events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select prominent incidents and synthesize multiple sites/episodes into coherent scenes based on authoritative chronicles or eyewitness manuscripts to balance dramatic need with historical veracity.
